Bug_Title: JUnit5 inner test classes should be annotated with @Nested
Bug_Explanation: The code demonstrates the JUnit5 bug where an inner test class is not annotated properly with @Nested, causing its tests to not be executed during standard test runs unless run manually in an IDE. Additionally, a static nested class incorrectly uses the @Nested annotation.
